description: Agent Oversight: submit the approval record (who approved, and where recorded the exact tool and arguments approved or the approval as worded) and the call as executed or as reconstructed after context compaction. The signed report says whether execution replays exactly what was approved, naming every argument that differs, was dropped or was added, with both values, and whether the tool matches. An approval with no exact arguments reads as unprovable. Tool-call approvals: approved documents against their current version are wever_approval-version-check. Verdict drifted, unprovable or exact. POST /api/approval-replay-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.
